summary: Lien on previous post under KCS Rules; Rule 252(b) and Rule 20 Note-4; relief post-appointment quashment; probation without confirmation; retention in prior post post-invalidated promotion; continuation of service and pensionary benefits; High Court reversal of Single Judge's order; interim stay during appeal; final restoration of status quo ante post-superannuation.
legal_provisions_cited: Karnataka Civil Service Rules, Rule 20 Note-4
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; Single Judge's order restored; entitlement to service and pensionary benefits upheld; promotion benefits denied due to superannuation.
